p.description: p value for the p-norm distance to calculate between each vector pair :math:`\in [0, \infty]`.
constraints: p must be in the interval (0, ∞) when using 'minkowski'
'minkowski' p-norm is used when p > 0, and Hamming distance is used when p = 0

output.description: The output will have shape :math:`\frac{1}{2} N (N - 1)`
